demo.seoIntro: Agnes Video Generator is a completely free AI creation tool that runs in your browser. Type one prompt and the site calls the Agnes models to turn text into an AI image, a single AI video clip, or a full multi-scene short film. Everything is organised into three tabs: Image generation, Simple video (text-to-video and image-to-video), and Creative video (an idea split into scenes and stitched together). seoFaq.q: Is this AI video generator free?
seoFaq.a: Yes. Agnes Video Generator is completely free. You only need your own free Agnes API Key (entered in the browser, stored locally)—no payment, no credit card.

seoFaq.q: Do I need to download or install software?
seoFaq.a: No. It's a fully web-based tool; open it in a browser to generate AI video and images online, on desktop or mobile.
Yes. Type a prompt for text-to-video, or upload a reference image for image-to-video; it runs on the limited-time-free Video 2.5 Flash model (4–12s, multiple aspect ratios).

seoFaq.q: Does it support text to image?
seoFaq.a: Yes. Type a prompt and agnes-image-2.1-flash generates AI images and art illustrations.

seoFaq.q: Do I need a credit card?
seoFaq.a: No credit card and no payment. The tool is free; you just enter your own free Agnes API Key.

seoFaq.q: Are my prompts and assets uploaded?
seoFaq.a: Your Agnes API Key is stored only in your browser's localStorage and is never uploaded to our servers; generation runs directly from your browser to the Agnes models.

seoFaq.q: Are there limits on the free version?
seoFaq.a: Video generation supports durations of 4–12s and multiple aspect ratios; your available quota depends on the free Agnes API Key you provide.

seoFaq.q: Can I use the videos and images commercially?
seoFaq.a: Commercial use depends on the Agnes API Key's license terms; please confirm your Key's usage rights before commercial use.
